# Configuration for Deepgram Whisper Cloud

To use this STT service in bot.py, replace the STT initialization with:

from pipecat.services.deepgram.stt import DeepgramSTTService

stt = DeepgramSTTService(
    api_key=os.getenv("API_KEY"),  # Use appropriate env var
    **{
    "model": "whisper-large",
    "language": "en-AU",
    "smart_format": true
}
)
